source.check: Londonderry Sentinel 17 May 1961 p1, read in the page image: Ardmore 'The only candidate nominated yesterday was Mr. Jack Buchanan' and 'The uncontested seats are:-' with ten divisions and names.

note: Triennial election of Londonderry Rural District Council, polled Thursday 1 June 1961. Two divisions, Glendermott and Claudy, were contested; the other eleven were filled unopposed at nomination on 16 May 1961 (Londonderry Sentinel, 17 May 1961, p. 1), including Ardmore, a Unionist gain. Returned unopposed.
correctionNote: Renamed from 'Ballymullan' to Ballymullins (13 Nov 2026, by the owner's rule for division spellings: the official or DED-map name where there is one, otherwise the spelling most rounds use): the DED maps of 1921-69 (BALLYMULLINS) spell it Ballymullins. This round was filed under the spelling 'Ballymullan', a form of the division's name it keeps as an alias; the old address (ballymullan) answers with a redirect to this one.
